items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: His teacher was the teacher of Clyde - what's his name - that went to Europe, the young kid that went to Europe

ctx.x: Oh, about the position of the hands.

You see, that's something else. Now, I'm going to play classical music, I'm sure, before I die, because ever since a little kid I wanted to do that. But I'm so involved with this and these other things that I like about jazz, see. I'm going to write some classical things and play them. The greatest concert pianist, Robert Harris - I don't think you met him but he's usually at my parties - he teaches over at Juilliard and if you ever want to know the piano and learn how to play the piano, get to him.
